title: AI QA Execution Journal — Event
description: One entry in platform/tasks/<task-name>/journal/execution-log.json → entries[]. Shared by every workflow stage. Records what actually happened; never contains fabricated runtime values. Optional stage-specific blocks (mcp_actions, observations, classifications, candidate_locators, coverage; test-design: techniques_used, generated_test_case_ids, test_cases, traceability, exploratory_cases, coverage_gaps, test_data_requirements; manual-execution: environment, build, browser, test_case_ids, executed_test_case_ids, execution_actions, test_results, statuses, failure_analysis, blocked_cases, test_case_issues, deviations, bugs, defect_grouping; test-review: review_binding, reviewed_test_case_ids, review_findings, review_outcome; automation-generation: automation_binding, automated_cases, locator_decisions, generated_files, static_validation) are used by stages that produce them (e.g. exploration, test-design). See docs/architecture/ai-qa-execution-journal.md.

schema_version.description: Schema version the event was written against. 1.3.0, 1.4.0, 1.5.0, 1.6.0 and 1.7.0 are backward-compatible supersets of 1.2.0 (optional stage blocks only; 1.7.0 adds automation_runs and healing_attempts; 1.6.0 also adds the status 'completed').

event_id.description: Sequential within the task journal: EVT-0001, EVT-0002, …

event_type.description: stage_execution = the stage ran (success or failure). revision_request = the human asked for changes. approval_decision = the human replied to a gate (accepted or not).

step_number.description: Position of this event in the journal (= numeric part of event_id).

attempt.description: Attempt number of this stage within the workflow run. Increments on every re-run/revision.

workflow_run_id.description: Read from journal/workflow-run.json → active_run_id. OWNED BY THE ORCHESTRATION LAYER: skills never create or invent it. null is allowed ONLY on a 'failed' stage_execution whose error is the missing run context.

timestamp.description: UTC, taken from the system clock at the moment of the event. Never estimated.

prompt_id.description: References journal/prompts.json. null only for events where no prompt was executed (e.g. approval_decision).

prompt_variables.description: Values substituted into the prompt's {{variables}} for this run.

user_message.description: Verbatim human message that caused the event (instruction, change request, or gate reply).

redactions.description: What was redacted from user_message (e.g. a password), if anything.

path.description: File path, URL (role project_url), or journal reference 'journal:EVT-NNNN' (role user_message / upstream_approval).

status.description: Files: read | missing | unreadable. URLs: accessed | not_accessed | inaccessible.

referenced_by.description: Where the input was referenced from, e.g. 'PRD §4.2'.

notes.description: e.g. access method and HTTP status for a URL, or why an input was not read.

source_references.description: Sources the output cites (e.g. PRD sections used for traceability).

mcp_used.description: Records MCP usage AND deliberate non-usage, so the HTML journal can show 'MCP: None' with the reason.

version.description: Server package/version as reported, or null if not determinable.

actions.description: Ordered list of what was actually done.

revision.description: Only on a stage_execution that revises an existing artifact (attempt > 1). null otherwise.

reason.description: Why the revision was made (summarizes the verbatim change request).

prompt_version_changed.description: true if this attempt used a different prompt_version than the previous attempt.

items_added.description: IDs added in this revision (e.g. TC-###).

items_removed.description: IDs withdrawn in this revision (IDs are never reused).

artifact_version.description: Version declared inside the artifact, e.g. PRD 1.1.0.

mcp_actions.description: Ordered log of MCP tool calls actually performed (e.g. browser opened, URL visited, form submitted, snapshot captured). Empty when no MCP was used.

tool.description: Exact MCP tool name as invoked.

action.description: Plain-language description of what was done.

target.description: URL, element description, or value category (secrets never recorded).

data_changing.description: true if the action created/changed/deleted application data.

human_confirmed.description: For destructive/irreversible/bulk actions: whether explicit human confirmation was obtained.

observations.description: Summary copies of the artifact observations (full detail lives in the artifact), so the HTML journal can navigate Observation → Classification → Evidence → Report.

sources.description: Upstream references, e.g. 'PC EB-003'; empty when ProjectContext is silent.

classifications.description: Counts per classification across active observations.

xpath_attribute.description: Observed attribute name and value, e.g. name="username". Never framework code.

coverage.description: Stage coverage block: exploration, test-design, manual-execution or test-review shape; null when not applicable.

techniques_used.description: Test-design technique applications (TA-###) and techniques deliberately not applied.

rationale.description: Why selected, or why not applied.

generated_test_case_ids.description: Active test case IDs in the artifact after this event.

expected_result_basis.description: e.g. 'PC EB-003 + OBS-007 (MATCH detail)' or 'Not established'.

test_data_requirements.description: Data required for execution. Never contains secret or credential values.

source.description: Where the data comes from (e.g. configured test-data source); never the secret value.

environment.description: Execution environment as recorded before the first case. Never fabricated; unknown values are null with unavailable_fields reasons.

test_data_source.description: Source names only; never secret values.

source.description: How it was determined (e.g. shown in UI footer, supplied by human).

execution_actions.description: Execution timeline: one entry per meaningful step action.

action.description: As written in the approved case.

data_ref.description: DATA-### or value category; never a secret value.

severity.description: Project model value, or Critical/High/Medium/Low (platform default).

review_binding.description: Test Review: the exact artifact versions the review applies to (ADR-001). A TEST_REVIEW_APPROVED approval is stale when any bound hash no longer matches the current approved artifact.

review_findings.description: Test Review findings (TR-###), including resolved and withdrawn ones. Change Required blocks TEST_REVIEW_APPROVED while open; Advisory does not.

sources.description: Approved source IDs or TestCases sections the finding rests on.

description.description: What is wrong, as observed in the reviewed TestCases.md version.

basis.description: The approved source or test-design rule that shows it.

proposed_change.description: What must change and where. Never applied by the review.

reference.description: TestCases version + TEST_DESIGN_APPROVED event, or the human's revision_request event.

decided_by.description: Downgrades (Change Required -> Advisory) are always human.

review_outcome.description: Test Review: changes_required exactly when at least one Change Required finding is open.

automation_binding.description: Automation Generation: the framework / language binding used and why (schema 1.6.0).

decision_source.description: Approved artifact ID, journal event, or platform default rule that decided the binding.

credential_env_vars.description: Environment variable NAMES only; never values.

automated_cases.description: Automation Generation: one entry per candidate case (Needs Automation = TRUE), generated or not.

locator_decisions.description: Automation Generation: every locator used, its strategy and its source (LOC-### or verification).

locator.description: As written in the generated code.

generated_files.description: Automation Generation: every file written, with its role and hash.

static_validation.description: Automation Generation: static checks (no run against the application).

automation_runs.description: Automation Execution: one entry per command run of one binding (schema 1.7.0). Never fabricated: unknown values are null.

command.description: As executed, with environment variable NAMES only; never values.

outcome.description: passed = all selected tests passed and the command succeeded; failed = at least one test failed; not_run = no test started; harness_failed = tests ran but the runner/build failed (never counted as a pass).

healing_attempts.description: Self-Healing: one entry per healing attempt (schema 1.7.0).

diagnosis_evidence.description: Evidence IDs or task-relative paths of the preserved failure evidence used.

change.description: What was changed; 'none' for an environment action or an application defect.

assertion_changed.description: Must be false. Expected results and assertions are never healed.

owner.description: null unless a source or the human explicitly named one.

status.description: State of the stage after this event. 'blocked' = a prerequisite was not met, so the stage did not start (no tools/MCP used, no artifact). 'failed' = the stage started but could not complete. 'completed' = an ungated stage finished successfully (no approval key; e.g. automation-generation).

stop_reason.description: Why the workflow stopped after this event.

approval_key.description: The literal key that unlocks the next stage.

approval_outcome.description: Only set on approval_decision events; null on all others.

condition.description: What must happen before the next stage may start.

evidence.description: Evidence items produced by this event. Empty when the stage produces none. Every item is real: captured from the system/tool, or explicitly not_captured with a reason.

source_action.description: mcp_actions[].seq (or tool/step description) that produced it.

path.description: Task-relative file path, or null if not captured / inline.

original_path.description: Where the tool wrote it before being moved into the task (e.g. .playwright-mcp/...).

redactions.description: What was redacted (e.g. auth token), if anything.

notes.description: Required when capture_status is not_captured: the actual reason.

testDesignCoverage.description: Test-design coverage (counts by type, sources covered/uncovered, observations considered).

reviewBoundArtifact.description: An approved artifact a Test Review is bound to (ADR-001).

approval_event_id.description: The accepted approval_decision event of the artifact's stage.

produced_by_event_id.description: The stage_execution event that produced this version, when known.

testReviewCoverage.description: Test-review coverage (cases reviewed, sources checked, findings by classification and category).
